b2-ma.title: Negation: Ma + Verb
b2-ma.explanation: ما (ma) negates a present-tense verb directly, with no extra word needed: ما أروح البيت اليوم (ma aruu7 el-bayt el-yoom, "I'm not going home today"). This is different from مب/مو, which only negate nouns and adjectives (مب زين, "not good") -- verbs always take ما.
b2-ma.fact: Gulf Arabic speakers sometimes drop the subject pronoun entirely and rely on the verb's own prefix to carry the person, so "ما أدري" alone (no أنا) is a completely normal, complete sentence for "I don't know."

dialogue.native: ما أدري وين البيت اليوم، والله
dialogue.en: I don't know where the house is today, honestly

dialogue.native: ما تقدر تدري؟ لازم تسأل صديقك
dialogue.en: You can't find out? You should ask your friend

lessons.title: I Don't Drink, I Don't Go

items.ar: ما أشرب قهوة اليوم لأن عطشان مويه بس زين
items.en: I'm not drinking coffee today because I'm just thirsty for water, that's fine
items.translit: ma ashrab gahwa el-yoom li-ann 3atshaan moya bas zayn

items.ar: ما تروح البيت الحين لأن الأهل مب هناك اليوم
items.en: You're not going home now because the family isn't there today
items.translit: ma truu7 el-bayt el-heen li-ann el-ahl mub hinaak el-yoom

items.ar: ما يشرب شاي اليوم لأن يبغى قهوة زين بس
items.en: He's not drinking tea today because he just wants good coffee
items.translit: ma yishrab shaay el-yoom li-ann yabgha gahwa zayn bas

items.ar: ما تدري وين البيت الجديد، لازم تدري اليوم بس
items.en: You don't know where the new house is, you should find out today
items.translit: ma tadri wein el-bayt el-jideed, laazim tadri el-yoom bas

items.ar: ما تروح المطعم اليوم لأن السعر غالي كثير هناك
items.en: She's not going to the restaurant today because the price is very expensive there
items.translit: ma truu7 el-mat3am el-yoom li-ann es-si3ir ghaali katheer hinaak

items.ar: ما ندري وين نروح بكرا لأن مشغولين كثير اليوم
items.en: We don't know where we're going tomorrow because we're very busy today
items.translit: ma nadri wein nruu7 bukra li-ann mashghooleen katheer el-yoom

items.ar: ما تشربون قهوة اليوم لأن عندكم شاي زين بس
items.en: You all aren't drinking coffee today because you just have good tea
items.translit: ma tishraboon gahwa el-yoom li-ann aandakum shaay zayn bas

items.ar: ما يدرون وين البيت، لازم يدرون اليوم بس
items.en: They don't know where the house is, they should find out today
items.translit: ma yadroon wein el-bayt, laazim yadroon el-yoom bas

items.ar: هذا البيت مب زين كثير، أبغى بيت جديد بكرا
items.en: This house isn't very good, I want a new house tomorrow
items.translit: hatha el-bayt mub zayn katheer, abgha bayt jideed bukra

items.ar: هذي السيارة مب رخيصة، السعر غالي كثير اليوم
items.en: This car isn't cheap, the price is very expensive today
items.translit: hathi es-sayyaara mub rikheesa, es-si3ir ghaali katheer el-yoom

items.ar: هذول الأهل مب مشغولين اليوم، لازم أروح بيتهم بكرا
items.en: This family isn't busy today, I should go to their house tomorrow
items.translit: hathool el-ahl mub mashghooleen el-yoom, laazim aruu7 baythum bukra

items.ar: ما أبغى هذا البيت لأن مب قريب زين اليوم
items.en: I don't want this house because it's not close and good today
items.translit: ma abgha hatha el-bayt li-ann mub gareeb zayn el-yoom

items.ar: ما أروح المطعم اليوم مب لأن مشغول، بس لأن تعبان
items.en: I'm not going to the restaurant today not because I'm busy, but because I'm tired
items.translit: ma aruu7 el-mat3am el-yoom mub li-ann mashghool, bas li-ann ta3baan

items.ar: ما تشرب قهوة الحين مب لأن ما تبغى، بس لأن تعبانة
items.en: You're not drinking coffee now not because you don't want to, but because you're tired
items.translit: ma tishrab gahwa el-heen mub li-ann ma tabgha, bas li-ann ta3baana

items.ar: ما يروح البيت مب لأن زعلان، بس لأن مشغول كثير
items.en: He's not going home not because he's upset, but because he's very busy
items.translit: ma yruu7 el-bayt mub li-ann za3laan, bas li-ann mashghool katheer

items.ar: ما ندري مب لأن مشغولين، بس لأن ما شفنا الأهل
items.en: We don't know not because we're busy, but because we haven't seen the family
items.translit: ma nadri mub li-ann mashghooleen, bas li-ann ma shifna el-ahl

items.ar: ما أشرب قهوة اليوم لأن أبغى شاي زين بس
items.en: I'm not drinking coffee today because I just want good tea
items.translit: ma ashrab gahwa el-yoom li-ann abgha shaay zayn bas

items.en: This house isn't very good, I don't want to go there tomorrow
items.translit: hatha el-bayt mub zayn katheer, ma abgha aruu7 hinaak bukra

items.en: You don't know where the family is not because you're busy, but because you're tired

items.en: We don't know where we're going tomorrow, we should find out today
items.translit: ma nadri wein nruu7 bukra, laazim nadri el-yoom bas

items.en: I don't want this house because the price is very expensive today
items.translit: ma abgha hatha el-bayt li-ann es-si3ir ghaali katheer el-yoom

items.ar: ما عندي فلوس كثير اليوم، ما أقدر أروح المطعم
items.en: I don't have a lot of money today, I can't go to the restaurant
items.translit: ma aandi fluus katheer el-yoom, ma aqdar aruu7 el-mat3am

items.ar: ما عنده فلوس زين اليوم، ما يشرب قهوة غالية بكرا
items.en: He doesn't have good money today, he's not drinking expensive coffee tomorrow
items.translit: ma aandah fluus zayn el-yoom, ma yishrab gahwa ghaalya bukra

items.ar: ما عندنا فلوس كثير اليوم، ما نروح المطعم الغالي بكرا
